 Jarrett Allen (knee) ruled out Saturday 
 by Chris Schommer | Cavaliers Correspondent | Sat, Nov 14th 2026, 6:11pm EST 
 Jarrett Allen (knee) has been ruled out for Saturday’s matchup between the Cleveland Cavaliers and Dallas Mavericks according to Christian Clark. ( Christian Clark on Twitter ) 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Allen will sit out alongside the rest of the Cleveland starting five for the second leg of a back-to-back, with Thomas Bryant to receive as many minutes as he can handle against the Mavericks for head coach Kenny Atkinson Saturday night.
 The Cavs are resting Donovan Mitchell, James Harden, Jarrett Allen and Peyton Watson against the Mavs tonight. They flew from Miami to Cleveland this morning.
— Christian Clark (@christianpclark) November 14, 2026
